title: Ruff v0.16.0 – Significant new updates – 413 default rules up from 59
summary: Ruff v0.16.0 is a major release of the blazing-fast Python linter written in Rust, dramatically increasing default rules from 59 to 413. This release positions Ruff as a comprehensive replacement for multiple Python linting tools while maintaining its signature speed advantage.
problem_solved: Provides ultra-fast Python linting with extensive rule coverage, replacing slower Python-based tools like Flake8 and isort.
why_valuable: Dramatically improves developer productivity by offering 10-100x faster linting with nearly 7x more default rules, simplifying Python code quality tooling.
